4957.title: Daemon WebSocket transport bypasses the environment proxy agent
4957.rootCauseOneLine: Daemon WebSocket dials omit an explicit agent; ws supplies createConnection, so Node bypasses its environment-aware global agent and resolves the destination directly.
4957.proposedFix: Choose an explicit proxy-aware WebSocket agent at the daemon dial boundary, with TLS verification and bypass handling preserved across supported Node versions. Review proxy credentials and loopback routing before implementation.
4957.caveats: Core WebSocket defect reproduced in two clean trusted checkouts. The machine-auth HTTP upstream already uses the declared proxy on Node 24.5.0 with NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1. Full enrollment, Node 25, and the connect gate were not exercised. No automatic PR: a complete dependency-free fix needs CONNECT/TLS and bypass policy for the supported Node 22 baseline, outside the security-boundary/product-decision allowance.
